olivia: Heads-up — noticed a ~10% spike in invoice-preview token counts for tenant `acme-inc` right after we toggled the soft-quota canary at 12:04 UTC. Preview and final invoice both show the extra tokens. looks like requests were routed to fallback + main and both got accounted. anyone else seeing this?
raj: Ugh. can you paste the canary id / deploy id? want to correlate routing events with metering ingest. also were these preview requests flagged as `is_preview`?
olivia: deploy-bot posted canary: `canary/2026-03-22T12:03Z/rc-7` in #deploys. preview flag is set in the payload but our metering consumer does a join on request_id; if routing rewrites request_id we lose dedupe.
carla: that matches a pattern i saw earlier — when route priority flips we temporarily duplicate requests because proxy fans out to both old+new route for a short window. last time we relied on `request_fingerprint` to dedupe but that field is only present on edge proxy v2. older clients still send `req_id` only.
raj: can you share a quick query to surface duplicates? i'll run it against the ingested events.
carla: sure — ran locally, this helps spot dupes across route tags:

```
-- find duplicated tenant tokens in 60s window
SELECT request_fingerprint, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE tenant_id = 'acme-inc' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-22T12:02:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T12:06:00Z'
GROUP BY request_fingerprint
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

carla: result: 452 rows with cnt=2 for that window, median duplicated tokens=48. majority have route_tag `canary-v2` + `fallback-main`.
sre_tanya: ingest-bot just emitted a warning: `ingest.deduper.missing-fingerprint` at 12:05:12; shows ~2.3k events in the consumer batch without fingerprint.
ingest-bot: WARN ingest.consumer batch_id=98765 missing_fingerprint=2307 canary_rollout=canary/2026-03-22T12:03Z
raj: ok — root cause is clear: fanout + missing fingerprint => double-count. mitigation options: 1) temporarily revert canary fanout to strict cutover, 2) patch metering consumer to use `(req_id, tenant, ts_rounded)` as fallback fingerprint, or 3) mark canary requests in a special tag and apply canary-only dedupe in final invoice generation.
olivia: preference for (2) short-term so we don't revert rollout. (3) is safer long-term but needs console + billing contract changes.
carla: we can do (2) quickly but be careful: `(req_id, tenant, ts_rounded)` risk of false-merge when clients retry within same second. we should use ts at millisecond granularity if available. current ingest schema has `ts_ms` on v2 events, but not v1.
raj: agree. patch plan: consumer will try `request_fingerprint`, else `req_id||'|'||tenant_id||'|'||coalesce(ts_ms, floor(ts_unix*1000))`. Add a provenance tag `dedupe_version=patch-20260322`. roll it canaryed to 10% of consumer shards.
sre_tanya: also add an alert: if dedupe rate < 99.5% or duplicated_token_count increases > 1% for 5m, page oncall.
carla: i'll prototype patch and push to canary shards. will add a feature flag so we can flip it back quickly.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: metering-consumer/patch-dedupe@canary shards=10% id=dc-20260322-12:12
olivia: thanks. quick ask: can console show a per-tenant "canary overlap" card so finance doesn't get noisy alerts during rollouts? currently invoices show preview -> spike and PMs start emailing ops.
raj: we could add a transient annotation on invoice-preview: `note: possible canary routing overlap` if `canary_rollout` present in ingestion metadata and dedupe_version != stable. easy UX patch in the console.
sre_tanya: make sure the annotation lives only in preview UI and not in final invoice PDF. finance hates surprises.
carla: rolling patch to canary shards now. will post results in ~8m. if we still see duplicates after dedupe fallback, revert plan is to pause fanout on proxy.
olivia: perfect. thanks team. :thumbsup:
carla: update: canary patch applied to shards. immediate reduction in duplicate cnt by ~92% in 2m sample. still seeing edge cases for events with missing ts_ms and same-second retries — down to 32 dupes in sample.
raj: please capture sample ids for those 32 and i'll trace back to client SDK versions.
carla: pasted 12 sample fingerprints in thread (omitted here).
sre_tanya: leaving alert enabled. will watch billing-emails channel for finance noise and mute temporarily if annotation works.
olivia: follow-ups: 1) console annotation for preview (raj), 2) add fingerprint to proxy v1 fallback (carla + infra), 3) long-term: canonical request id upstream (product). i'll add tickets.
raj: i'll take the console card. added ticket: PLAT-6821.
carla: opened infra ticket: PLAT-6822 to add fingerprint to proxy v1.
olivia: closing loop — thanks all, happy to escalate to execs if finance gets noisy but looks good so far.
